topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines how the session will integrate previously learned components of the immune system to examine the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by the Innate Immune System
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue injury through conserved molecular patterns and diverse pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cell Activation, Trafficking, and Systemic Manifestations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell recruitment, lymphatic transit, and systemic physiological responses during inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how the body ceases inflammatory signaling, repairs damaged tissue, and manages persistent insults through chronic structures like granulomas.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture Topic
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the subject of the upcoming lecture.
